MERGED INTO LIVE-938 2026-10-20. Needs one design ruling for rank hues and sits in the same colour sweep as design area 4, which LIVE-938 carries. The original probe is unchanged in this row's history.

RULED 2026-10-20 (Daniel, decision card: One iridescent look). Under Frequency a reached season rank (Initiate, Adept, Master) is the --fq-pa pill with ink text and Ghost a plain track pill (app/themes/frequency.css); RankBadge stamps data-season-rank so the shared spectrum keys (pillar dots, Space accents) keep their hues. The --rank-* alias the row first proposed is not needed, so the probe now measures the ruled look.
